messages:
karim: Heads up — during the synthetic short-chat burst at ~03:53 UTC p95 token latency jumped ~1.8x for svc-chat-short. Link to dashboard: https://graf.redwood/s/dash/short-chat :eyes:
nora: noticed the same on traces. Kernel selection shows rapid toggles between tensor-core and avx paths on the same request id. Might be mid-request fallback churn.
jin: captured a flame/trace from a repro run. key bits below:
```
profile: kernel_select try tensor_core (12ms) -> fallback avx (9ms) -> retry tensor_core (11ms)
runtime: batch.drain joiners=0 hold_ms=0 -> flush
kv_prefetch: upstream 503 for hot-prefix a1b2 (retry 1) -> miss -> kv_attach fanout x3 (+18ms)
```
karim: that kv_prefetch 503 was odd — prefetch-service had a short spike of 5xxs at 03:50 UTC per logs. deploy-bot, any recent changes to prefetch client?
deploy-bot: deploy v2026.03.29 rolled kernel-selector heuristic to canary pools at 02:47 UTC (sha: fa9c3d). No changes to prefetch client in that deploy.
ops-bot: infra note: pool-warmpool-A reported CPU steal on one host from noisy batch jobs around 03:49 UTC, but OOMs/evictions look clean.
nora: hypothesis: two compounding effects — (1) upstream prefetch 5xx -> KV miss & fanout adding tail time, (2) new kernel heuristic increases mid-request fallback probability which breaks batching joiner assumptions, causing more single-request batches. Both amplify p95.
karim: agree. Quick experiment idea: add a small joiner window (joiner_window_ms=10) and disable mid-request kernel fallback to stabilize kernel choice for the duration of the request. Also add a short retry/backoff in prefetch client for known-hot prefixes.
jin: prototyping now on canary-warmpool. Patch toggles:
```
batching.joiner_window_ms = 10
kernel.selection.allow_midrequest_fallback = false
prefetch.client.max_retries = 2
```
karim: good. run the synthetic burst and post p50/p95 numbers.
(canary run ~10m later)
jin: canary results: baseline p95=240ms, p95 with flags=135ms, p50 ~ unchanged. Token throughput steady. No obvious GPU kernel errors in logs. :thumbsup:
nora: promising — suggests the fallback oscillation + fanout were the culprit. We should still fix root cause of the prefetch 5xxs (upstream timeouts) but this config buy us time.
karim: action items:
- jin: promote config flags to canary-wide for 1h soak, collect full traces (in progress)
- nora: open issue to add exponential backoff and hot-prefix short-circuit in prefetch client (postmortem task)
- ops: investigate noisy-host scheduling that caused CPU steal, consider isolating warmpool nodes from batch jobs
- deploy-bot: if canary holds for 1h, schedule a controlled rollout to main warmpool with rollback guard

karim: leaving this thread to monitor. tagging incident INC-2026-2214 for tracking.
canary-bot: incident INC-2026-2214 annotated: short-chat joiner-delay + kernel-churn regression.
